content: भाषा [भाष्-अ] .²1 Speech, talk; as in चारुभाषः. .²2 Language, tongue; सत्या न भाषा भवति यद्यपि स्यात् प्रतिष्ठिता <ls>Ms. 8. 164</ls>. .²3 A common or vernacular dialect; .³({%a%}) the {%spoken%} Sanskṛt language (<ab>opp.</ab> छन्दस् or वेद); विभाषा भाषायाम् <ls>P. VI. 1. 181</ls>; .³({%b%}) any Prākṛta dialect (<ab>opp.</ab> संस्कृत); भाषाश्च विविधा नृणाम् <ls>Ms. 9. 332</ls>; see प्राकृत. .²4 Definition, description; स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा <ls>Bg. 2. 54</ls>. .²5 An epithet of Sarasvatī, the goddess of speech. .²6 (In law) The first of the four stages of a law-suit; the plaint, charge or accusation; यदावेदयते राज्ञे तद्भाषेत्यभिधीयते <ls>Y.</ls> .²7 (In music) <ab>N.</ab> of a Rāgiṇī.
